text:
Posted by Sebastian Weber on Jun 29th, 2018 // No Comments
Evermay Wealth Management LLC increased its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 25.6% during the fourth quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The firm owned 28,649 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 5,845 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises 1.8% of Evermay Wealth Management LLC’s holdings, making the stock its 9th largest holding. Evermay Wealth Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $4,848,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
Several other institutional investors also recently bought and sold shares of AAPL. NuWave Investment Management LLC bought a new stake in shares of Apple during the fourth quarter valued at approximately $625,000. Wealthstreet Investment Advisors LLC bought a new stake in Apple during the fourth quarter worth $26,582,000. Trilogy Capital Inc. bought a new stake in Apple during the fourth quarter worth $381,000. Gerber Kawasaki Wealth & Investment Management grew its holdings in Apple by 3.8% during the fourth quarter. Gerber Kawasaki Wealth & Investment Management now owns 73,317 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $12,407,000 after buying an additional 2,711 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Fusion Family Wealth LLC grew its holdings in Apple by 2,699.6% during the fourth quarter. Fusion Family Wealth LLC now owns 7,783 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,317,000 after buying an additional 7,505 shares in the last quarter. 58.07% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors. Apple traded down $0.39, hitting $185.11, during trading hours on Friday, according to Marketbeat.com . 22,541,319 shares of the company were exchanged, compared to its average volume of 32,918,168. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80, a current ratio of 1.46 and a quick ratio of 1.37. Apple Inc. has a 52 week low of $142.41 and a 52 week high of $194.20. The stock has a market capitalization of $934.43 billion, a P/E ratio of 20.10, a PEG ratio of 1.52 and a beta of 1.29.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 EPS for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.69 by $0.04. The firm had revenue of $61.14 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $60.94 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 39.97% and a net margin of 21.55%. The company’s quarterly revenue was up 15.6% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter in the prior year, the firm posted $2.10 earnings per share. equities research analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.42 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
Apple announced that its Board of Directors has initiated a share repurchase plan on Tuesday, May 1st that permits the company to repurchase $100.00 billion in shares. This repurchase authorization permits the iPhone maker to buy up to 11.9% of its stock through open market purchases. Stock repurchase plans are usually a sign that the company’s board believes its shares are undervalued.
Several brokerages recently issued reports on AAPL. Atlantic Securities reiterated a “neutral” rating and set a $185.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, May 2nd. BidaskClub cut Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a research report on Friday, June 8th. BMO Capital Markets upped their price target on Apple from $166.00 to $171.00 and gave the company a “market perform” rating in a research report on Wednesday, May 2nd. Barclays upped their price target on Apple from $157.00 to $161.00 and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a research report on Wednesday, May 2nd. Finally, Zacks Investment Research raised Apple from a “sell” rating to a “hold” rating in a research report on Thursday, May 3rd. One analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, sixteen have given a hold rating, thirty-one have issued a buy rating and two have issued a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. Apple presently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $207.20.
In related news, COO Jeffrey E. Williams sold 15,653 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, June 8th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.94, for a total value of $2,988,783.82. Following the completion of the sale, the chief operating officer now owns 147,819 shares in the company, valued at $28,224,559.86. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through the SEC website . Also, insider Angela J. Ahrendts sold 6,568 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, June 15th. The shares were sold at an average price of $188.81, for a total value of $1,240,104.08. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 79,476 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $15,005,863.56. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last ninety days, insiders have sold 279,074 shares of company stock worth $49,607,454. Insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock.
Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
